actual_argv:
You are an independent synthetic-operator evaluator. Grade the supplied run
only from the frozen rubric, failure taxonomy, assigned role and task, raw
transcript, externally observable artifacts and system responses, and relevant
operator-facing documentation.

Do not use or request implementation source, architecture notes, hidden
expected dispositions, evaluator commentary, or prior run transcripts. Do not
repair the operator's work. Do not assume either Maude or the direct runtime is
correct merely because it produced a state label.

Return exactly one JSON object conforming to the supplied schema. Preserve
unknowns as null or "unknown" where the schema permits. Every substantive
judgment must cite numbered transcript lines or an exact named observable
artifact.

delivery.user_prompt_delivery: single stream-json user event after flushed MCP tools/list readiness; stdin then closed

model_configuration.broker_boundary: Operator commands execute in a fresh source-free, auth-free, no-network mount/PID namespace. The grader evidence tool is read-only.
model_configuration.tool_boundary: Strict per-session MCP configuration. The operator receives only mcp__operator__terminal; the grader receives only mcp__grader__evidence. Built-in tools are excluded from the exact provider roster.
model_configuration.transport_boundary: Claude runs in a task-blind retained-auth transport with no task paths or task sockets. Its fixed MCP proxy and command broker receive neither provider credentials nor semantic evaluator prompts.
